## Notes

- **Job description and write paths.** `references/lanes/skills.md`; content writes only through `scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs` / `label-write.mjs` / `issue-create.mjs` / `close-cards.mjs` and `fleet-write/dispatch.mjs --actions-file` (all accept `--repo objectstack-ai/objectui`); a body refresh needs `--ack-through=ID`. This session's route: `dispatch` (relay `fleet-write.yml` on `main`, Actions `active`).
- **Landing.** Tier H = an authorized APPROVED review, then the seat clears `needs-user-decision` and lands (`pr_ready` + `automerge_enable`), unless the approver already did; Tier S (`.claude/**`) = at-tier review PASS then the seat lands; non-governed = CI + the seat's read. Landing = MERGED through the queue (`added_to_merge_queue` on the timeline, then MERGED confirmed by content on `origin/main`).
- **Sister-repo claims.** objectui's `AGENTS.md` bans model identifiers in comments; the recogniser accepts `model: CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` with `MANDATORY` cited on the same line — used on every claim this shift; PR #21269 taught the template the same.
- **Platform readings this shift (for the next seat):** ① `write-pace` (40 writes / trailing hour) is per container token and SHARED by the seat and every dev it runs — with 3 devs in flight the budget binds (exit 10 = refused, nothing written; the tool prints the reopen instant); the seat queues its writes in protocol order and drains as slots free. ② `post-stamped` refuses a bare `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mmZ` quoted from a brief unless wrapped as a declared reading (MIXED, exit 2, nothing written); flags take the `=` form (`--repo=owner/name`). ③ Container Node v22.22.0 is below jsdom@30's `^22.22.2` floor under objectui's `engine-strict` — devs install with `--config.engine-strict=false` (deviation recorded). ④ Inside a subagent, the auto-mode permission classifier refused one `label-write` stroke and one `gh api … GET` as "External System Writes" (PR #21283's dev); nothing was written; the seat does not perform a refused dev write on the dev's behalf — it surfaces it on the ACCEPT, the 速读 and here. ⑤ The container cannot read a fleet-write run's job log (302 → blob, CONNECT 403) or `output.summary` (null); annotations are readable — #21294. ⑥ A cloud session reads only repositories attached to it (others 403 at REST, MCP, GraphQL, `/search`); the GitHub search API is unavailable (repo-scoped endpoints only), so dedupe runs over repo-scoped lists.
- **Checkout**: `/home/user/objectstack` at `6c5bef5f` and `/home/user/objectui` at `990a2d61` (both = `origin/main` at this refresh; fast-forwarded nine times this shift when `check-harness-current.mjs` read STALE after the seat's own landings — CURRENT now; the session is changed only at a natural shift boundary, never mid-batch).
